v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: The Lord is a great King * Come, let us adore Him.

la: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.en: I will praise the name of God.

r.en: And I will magnify him with praise.

text.la: In Deo salutáre meum * et glória mea: et spes mea in Deo est.
text.en: In God is my salvation * and my glory: and my hope is in God.

text.la: Vidéte ópera Dómini, * et audítam fácite vocem laudis eius.
text.en: Behold the works of the Lord * and make the voice of his praise to be heard.

text.la: Audíte, omnes * qui timétis Deum, quanta fecit ánimæ meæ.
text.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God * what great things he hath done for my soul.

text.la: Exsúrgat Deus, * et dissipéntur inimíci eius. ‡
text.en: Let God arise, * and let his enemies be scattered. ‡

text.la: Deus noster, * Deus salvos faciéndi: et Dómini sunt éxitus mortis.
text.en: Our God * is the God of salvation: and the Lord of the issues from death.
In the churches * bless ye God the Lord.

text.la: Salvum me fac, * Deus, quóniam intravérunt aquæ usque ad ánimam meam. ‡
text.en: Save me, O God * for the waters are come in even unto my soul. ‡

text.la: Propter inimícos meos * éripe me, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, save me * from my enemies.

text.la: Quǽrite Dóminum, * et vivet ánima vestra.
text.en: Look for the Lord * and your soul shall live.

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: Exáudi, Dómine Iesu Christe, preces servórum tuórum, et miserére nobis: Qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: O Lord Jesus Christ, graciously hear the prayers of Thy servants, and have mercy upon us, Who livest and reignest with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, ever world without end.

benedictio.la: Benedictióne perpétua benedícat nos Pater ætérnus.
benedictio.en: May the Eternal Father bless us with an eternal blessing.

source.en: Lesson from the book of Job

text.la: 1 Respóndens autem Dóminus Iob de túrbine, dixit: 2 Quis est iste invólvens senténtias sermónibus imperítis? 3 Accínge, sicut vir, lumbos tuos; interrogábo te et respónde mihi. 4 Ubi eras quando ponébam fundaménta terræ? Indica mihi, si habes intellegéntiam. 5 Quis pósuit mensúras eius, si nosti? vel quis teténdit super eam líneam? 6 Super quo bases illíus solidátæ sunt? aut quis demísit lápidem angulárem eius, 7 Cum me laudárent simul astra matutína, et iubilárent omnes fílii Dei?
text.en: 1 Then the Lord answered Job out of a whirlwind, and said: 2 Who is this that wrappeth up sentences in unskillful words? 3 Gird up thy loins like a man I will ask thee, and answer thou me. 4 Where wast thou when I laid up the foundations of the earth tell me if thou hast understanding. 5 Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it? 6 Upon what are its bases grounded? or who laid the corner stone thereof, 7 When the morning stars praised me together, and all the sons of God made a joyful melody?

body.la: Si bona suscépimus de manu Dei, mala autem quare non sustineámus?
body.en: What shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?

refrain.la: Dóminus dedit, Dóminus ábstulit; sicut Dómino plácuit, ita factum est: sit nomen Dómini benedíctum.
refrain.en: The Lord gave and the Lord hath taken away. As the Lord hath pleased, so hath it befallen. Blessed be the Name of the Lord.

verse.la: Nudus egréssus sum de útero matris meæ et nudus revértar illuc.
verse.en: Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither.

benedictio.la: Unigénitus Dei Fílius nos benedícere et adiuváre dignétur.
benedictio.en: May the Son, the Sole-begotten, mercifully bless and keep us.

text.la: 8 Quis conclúsit óstiis mare, quando erumpébat quasi de vulva procédens, 9 Cum pónerem nubem vestiméntum eius, et calígine illud, quasi pannis infántiæ, obvólverem? 10 Circúmdedi illud términis meis, et pósui vectem et óstia, 11 Et dixi: Usque huc vénies, et non procédes ámplius, et hic confrínges tuméntes fluctus tuos. 12 Numquid post ortum tuum præcepísti dilúculo, et ostendísti auróræ locum suum? 13 Et tenuísti concútiens extréma terræ, et excussísti ímpios ex ea?
text.en: 8 Who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke forth as issuing out of the womb? 9 When I made a cloud the garment thereof, and wrapped it in a mist as in swaddling bands? 10 I set my bounds around it, and made it bars and doors. 11 And I said: Hitherto thou shalt come, and shalt go no further, and here thou shalt break thy swelling waves. 12 Didst thou since thy birth command the morning, and shew the dawning of the day its place? 13 And didst thou hold the extremities of the earth shaking them, and hast thou shaken the ungodly out of it?

body.la: Antequam cómedam, suspíro, et tamquam inundántes aquæ sic rugítus meus; quia timor, quem timébam, evénit mihi, et quod verébar áccidit. Nonne dissimulávi? nonne sílui? nonne quiévi?
body.en: My sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters, for the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me. Was not I silent? Held not I my peace? Was not I at rest?

verse.la: Ecce non est auxílium mihi in me, et necessárii quoque mei recessérunt a me.
verse.en: Behold, I cannot help myself, and they that were needful unto me have forsaken me.

benedictio.la: Spíritus Sancti grátia illúminet sensus et corda nostra.
benedictio.en: May the grace of the Holy Spirit enlighten all our hearts and minds.

text.la: 14 Restituétur ut lutum signáculum, et stabit sicut vestiméntum: 15 Auferétur ab ímpiis lux sua, et brácchium excélsum confringétur? 16 Numquid ingréssus es profúnda maris, et in novíssimis abýssi deambulásti? 17 Numquid apértæ sunt tibi portæ mortis, et óstia tenebrósa vidísti? 18 Numquid considerásti latitúdinem terræ? Indica mihi, si nosti, ómnia: 19 In qua via lux hábitet, et tenebrárum quis locus sit; 20 Ut ducas unumquódque ad términos suos, et intéllegas sémitas domus eius.
text.en: 14 The seal shall be restored as clay, and shall stand as a garment. 15 From the wicked their light shall be taken away, and the high arm shall be broken. 16 Hast thou entered into the depths of the sea, and walked in the lowest parts of the deep? 17 Have the gates of death been opened to thee, and hast thou seen the darksome doors? 18 Hast thou considered the breadth of the earth? tell me, if thou knowest all things? 19 Where is the way where light dwelleth, and where is the place of darkness? 20 That thou mayst bring every thing to its own bounds, and understand the paths of the house thereof.

body.la: Quare detraxístis sermónibus veritátis? ad increpándum verba compónitis et subvértere nitímini amícum vestrum:
body.en: Why do ye argue against the words of truth? Do ye imagine words to reprove me and strive to confound one that is your friend?

refrain.en: Nevertheless, finish that ye have in mind.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Tua nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, grátia semper et prævéniat et sequátur: ac bonis opéribus iúgiter præstet esse inténtos.
text.en: Lord, we pray thee, that thy grace may always prevent and follow us, and make us continually to be given to all good works.

office.title: Feria Quinta infra Hebd XVI post Octavam Pentecostes II. Septembris
